events.title: Submission — le portrait de Saint Agathe – Bryana Fritz
events.note: Performance by Bryana Fritz at 19h; the PAC agenda gives Fri 18 Dec, the 3 bis F member page Sat 19 Dec.

events.title: Casse-Noisette – Ballet & Orchestre
events.note: Touring production of Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker with ballet company and live orchestra (Paris & tournée 2026/2027).

events.title: Les Fesses-tivités de Noël
events.note: Christmas edition of the Massilia Burlesque Show by the Collectif Energétique, mixing burlesque striptease, dance, circus and mime.

events.title: Un moment suspendu
events.venue: Théâtre de l'Astronef (La Criée hors les murs)
events.note: Pauline Sales's Jeune Troupe piece about a young woman starting a korfball team in Marseille, played hors les murs at the Théâtre de l'Astronef (Centre hospitalier Édouard Toulouse) on 18 and 19 December at 20:00.

events.title: Yan Péchin et Emma Foreman + Brother Junior
events.note: Concert by guitarist Yan Péchin with Emma Foreman, supported by Brother Junior (20:00–23:00).

events.title: Mad Rey B2B Mezigue : All Night Long
events.venue: Petit Cab, Friche la Belle de Mai
events.note: All-night back-to-back DJ set by French house producers Mad Rey and Mezigue, 23:30–04:30.

events.title: Au creux de l'hiver
events.note: Children's winter show programmed in Divadlo's Christmas festival on the first weekend of the holidays.

events.title: Dame Neige
events.note: 40-minute storytelling show by Aurélie Lejeune (folk tales, rhymes and songs from several countries) for ages 3 to 6, with La Baleine qui dit « Vagues ». Two sessions, 15h30 and 16h30, Salle Ouranos; both listed as sold out, same-day tickets possible on site.

events.title: Fantaisies sur Walt Disney
events.note: Pianist Jean-François Zygel improvises on themes from Walt Disney films.

events.title: Pitchouns — festival pour le jeune public
events.note: Year-end children's festival at the villa Noailles with a treasure hunt, workshops for ages 6–16, a bouncy castle, child-friendly exhibition tours and a Christmas boutique, 19 and 20 December 2026.

events.title: Prométhée
events.note: One-hour ballet by Martin Harriague for the Ballet de l'Opéra Grand Avignon, to Beethoven's Creatures of Prometheus and music by Fabien Cali, with the Orchestre national Avignon-Provence under Swann van Rechem; Sat 20:00, Sun 16:00.

events.title: Atelier de dabké traditionnelle et contemporaine
events.note: Pulsations ! workshop (14:30–17:00, J4) in which Mohanad Smama introduces the Palestinian dabké, a communal dance tied to solidarity and heritage, in traditional and contemporary forms.

events.title: Calend'Arles — Parade des arts du cirque et spectacle pyrotechnique
events.note: Circus-arts procession from 15:30, then parade and pyrotechnic show at 17:00 on place de la République, within Calend'Arles 2026 (4–30 December).

events.title: 2L
events.note: Rap concert by 2L at Le Dodu, listed in the Molotov agenda.

events.title: Ateliers avec le Chœur tac-til et projection de « Un chant aveugle »
events.note: Workshops with the Chœur tac-til at 15:00 and 17:00 followed by a 19:00 screening of the film Un chant aveugle, closing day of the exhibition 130 messages et une colère.

events.title: Les Mutantes
events.note: Cabaret by the collective Les Mutantes, part of the theatre's four queer weekends of the season.

events.title: Dj Schnake : All Night Long
events.venue: Petit Cab, Friche la Belle de Mai
events.note: All-night DJ set by Dj Schnake at the Petit Cab, presented by EXTRA, 23:30–04:30.

events.title: Le Noël Marseillais – Spectacle de drones et feu d'artifice
events.note: Drone show and fireworks around the Vieux-Port closing the Noël Marseillais weekend programme (details to come, per the tourist office page updated 19 Nov 2026).

events.title: Ciné-Dimanche : Persepolis
events.note: Monthly Sunday screening in the Mucem auditorium ('A Sunday in Tehran'): the animated film Persepolis by Marjane Satrapi and Vincent Paronnaud, introduced and followed by a discussion.

events.title: Les Heures d'orgue de Saint-Victor
events.note: December session of the free organ recital series on the abbey's historic organ, played by Agnès Nurdin, Gilles Cidale, Stéphane Rigat and Patrick Geel.

events.title: Le voyage magique de Noël
events.note: Visual and sound show for very young children in which Lulu the sprite leads them through a bustling Christmas village after Santa's gift room is found empty; sessions at 10:00 and 11:15 on 22 and 23 December, 8 €.

events.title: Le Rêve de Sam et autres courts
events.note: Ensemble Télémaque (Charlotte Campana, Christian Bini, Jean-Florent Gabriel, Raoul Lay) plays live to four animated shorts including The Fox and the Whale, Jonas and the Sea, Home Sweet Home and Le Rêve de Sam; sessions at 10:00 and 14:30, 41 min, from 3, free by reservation (Tous en Sons).

events.title: Calend'Arles — Grande parade de Noël et feu d'artifice
events.note: Grand Christmas parade through the city centre at 18:00 followed by fireworks over the quais du Rhône at 19:00, the closing highlight of Calend'Arles 2026.

events.title: La Périchole
events.note: Offenbach's opéra-bouffe about a Lima street singer who becomes the Viceroy of Peru's mistress, directed by Jean-Christophe Mast and conducted by Gaspard Brécourt with Éléonore Pancrazi, Kaëlig Boché and Marc Barrard; first performance Sunday 27 December at 14:30, then 29 and 31 December (20:00), 3 and 5 January.

events.title: Le goûter à histoires
events.note: A storyteller and the chef of the Café du Fort pair tales with original tastings in the Forum (J4), several sessions a day, from 5 years (Vacances gourmandes).

events.title: Vacances gourmandes
events.note: Christmas-holiday family programme around the exhibition Manger les images: Le goûter à histoires (27–28 Dec), the free pastry workshop Gâteaux d'art (27 Dec–3 Jan, ages 6–11), Le banquet des images (30–31 Dec) and Le goûter des images for ages 1–3 (2–3 Jan).

events.title: Greli grelo
events.note: Nadine Nicolau (Nadine & Cie / Les Crapules) performs a Christmas show for babies from 6 months about Philou the penguin and Bambou the panda, daily at 10:00 between Christmas and New Year.

events.title: Gâteaux d'art
events.note: Free pastry workshop (15:30–17:00, Restaurant Bouillant, J4) in which children aged 6 to 11 make edible artworks with a chef from the restaurant and then taste them (Vacances gourmandes).

events.title: L'Homme à l'oreille coupée
events.note: Badaboum Théâtre's 50-minute adaptation of Jean-Claude Mourlevat's tale about a man who gives a different story each time he is asked how he lost his ear, from age 3; plays through the Christmas holidays.

events.title: K-Pop Forever !
events.note: Live K-pop show with dancers and visual effects performing hits by Blackpink, BTS, Twice and others.

events.title: Les Pêcheurs de perles
events.note: Bizet's opera is the Opéra de Toulon's year-end lyric production, with performances on 29 and 31 December at 20:00.

events.title: Signé Offenbach
events.note: Staged lyric concert of Offenbach excerpts (La Vie parisienne, Les Contes d'Hoffmann, Le Voyage dans la Lune, La Périchole, La Belle Hélène) with Amélie Robins, Mathilde Ortscheidt, Loïc Felix, Florent Karrer, the Opéra chorus and the Orchestre national Avignon-Provence under Sammy El Ghadab; 31 December at 20:00 (followed by a paid New Year cocktail) and 3 January at 15:00.

events.title: Candlelight : Les Quatre Saisons de Vivaldi
events.note: Candlelit string-quartet concert of Vivaldi's Four Seasons with Massenet's Méditation de Thaïs, Piazzolla's Libertango and Max Richter's recomposed Seasons (Fever); the listing gives the Pharo as address but Cosquer Méditerranée in the text.
